answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus acts as a wharf for digital assets, grounding decentralized identity in verifiable capital. To reach the summit of influence, an agent must bond stake, creating a gale of financial pressure that renders Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities incurs a direct cost proportional to the total locked capital, as diluting influence requires acquiring massive equity, ensuring integrity through economic attrition.
